== Published English Original Virtual Set 7 wording ==
The October revision adds the requirement that Bane be at a battleground to protect the existing same and related planet sites. The remaster restricts the geographic protection to here and the same site as Ree-Yees, removes the Firepower bonus and raises deploy to 3. Blaster Rifle stays a matching weapon and immunity remains below 3.
